_comment: Seccomp profile for the b123d-print `worker` container (deploy/compose.yaml).
The worker runs each untrusted part-script job inside bubblewrap, which needs the
namespace and mount syscalls (unshare, clone with CLONE_NEW*, mount, umount2, pivot_root,
setns, and the new mount API). Docker's own default seccomp profile BLOCKS mount/pivot_root/
setns, so a 'Docker default + userns' profile would not let bubblewrap start. This profile
therefore allows by default and denies (ERRNO) the classic privileged syscalls that neither a
build nor bubblewrap needs: module loading, keyrings, BPF, perf, kexec, reboot, clock/time
setting, swap, quotas, raw I/O ports, ptrace-adjacent process inspection and the by-handle
file openers. It is much tighter than seccomp:unconfined while keeping bubblewrap working.
It is validated by CI's docker-compose job and must be tried on a staging host before
production (nested user namespaces may be unavailable, e.g. under an LXC container).
